ideas.pitch: A radical redesign of timeline-based video editing interfaces that replaces tracks and keyframes with spatial, node-based branching memory to eliminate version control chaos.
ideas.title: ChronoCanvas: Non-Linear Temporal Navigation for Creative Software
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting a 24-hour designathon focused on questioning conventional UX paradigms, this tackles the deeply ingrained friction of traditional linear editing timelines with a radically new interaction model.

ideas.pitch: An interface design utility that dynamically shifts font weight, kerning, and visual hierarchy in real-time based on the user's peripheral gaze distance and ambient lighting.
ideas.title: AuraType: Context-Aware Spatial Typography and Dynamic Hierarchy Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the focus areas of UI/UX design and interaction design by pushing visual typography beyond static constraints into responsive digital environments.

ideas.pitch: A complete reimagining of mobile and desktop operating systems that eliminates nested menus and icons entirely, replacing them with intent-driven haptic and gesture gestures.
ideas.title: Synapse: Zero-Menu Operating System Concept for Spatial Computing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Design judges at a 24-hour sprint look for foundational challenges to digital products; proposing an entirely new interaction model makes for a compelling visual presentation and pitch.

ideas.pitch: A conversational and spatial form interface that dynamically morphs and builds input fields based on previous answers, reducing cognitive overload in government and medical documentation.
ideas.title: EchoForm: Generative Form-Filling UX for Complex Bureaucratic Workflows
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines creative problem solving with practical digital product design, demonstrating high utility and empathetic UI/UX that appeals directly to evaluation panels.

ideas.pitch: A tool that audits and visualizes app navigation paths as an interactive force-directed graph to instantly highlight dead-ends, friction points, and redundant user journeys.
ideas.title: NudgeGraph: Intent-Based Information Architecture Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a meta-design solution that empowers other designers, showcasing a high degree of creative problem-solving and visual design polish within a tight 24-hour window.
